1. The relationship between tcc and lst 2013-2021
```{r}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_tcc.R")


# year 2015
rs_tcc <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/nlcd_tcc_NY_2015.tif"))
rs_lst <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/2015.tif")) %>%
  projectRaster(., rs_tcc, method = "ngb")

output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/tcc_lst_2015.jpg")
scatters_tcc_lst(tree= rs_tcc, lst = rs_lst,
                 xlabel = expression(bold(paste('Tree Canopy Cover / %', sep = ''))),
                 ylabel = expression(bold(paste('Land Surface Temp / °C', sep = ''))), 
                 output_file = output_dir)
  
```

2. The relationship between lst and phenology index(sos,eos from Li, 2019) 2013-2021
```{r cars}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_phe.R")

rs_phe <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/phenology_Li/SOS_2015.tif"))
rs_lst <- raster(stringr::str_c("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/nlcd_tcc_NY_2015.tif")) %>%
  projectRaster(., rs_phe, method = "ngb")
output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/sos_tcc_2015.jpg")
scatters_lst_phe(rs_lst = rs_lst,rs_phe= rs_phe,
                 xlabel = expression(bold(paste('Tree Canopy Cover / ', sep = ''))),
                 ylabel = expression(bold(paste('Start of Season / DOY', sep = ''))),
                 output_file = output_dir)

```

3. The relationship between tcc and lst 2013-2021 (different season/month)
```{r}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_phe.R")

#2014-2015 winter
rs_201412 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2014_12.tif")
rs_201501 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_01.tif")
rs_201502 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_02.tif")
raster_list <- list(rs_201412, rs_201501, rs_201502)
raster_stack <- stack(raster_list)
rs_2015winter <- mean(raster_stack)

#2015 spring
rs_201503 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_03.tif")
rs_201504 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_04.tif")
rs_201505 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_05.tif")
raster_list2 <- list(rs_201503, rs_201504, rs_201505)
raster_stack2 <- stack(raster_list2)
rs_2015spring <- mean(raster_stack2)

#2015 summer
rs_201506 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_06.tif")
rs_201507 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_07.tif")
rs_201508 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_08.tif")
raster_list3 <- list(rs_201506, rs_201507, rs_201508)
raster_stack3 <- stack(raster_list3)
rs_2015summer <- mean(raster_stack3)

#2015 autumn
rs_201509 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_09.tif")
rs_201510 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_10.tif")
rs_201511 <- raster("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/LST_L8/month_mean/2015_11.tif")
raster_list4 <- list(rs_201509, rs_201510, rs_201511)
raster_stack4 <- stack(raster_list4)
rs_2015autumn <- mean(raster_stack4)

rs_phe <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/phenology_Li/SOS_2015.tif"))
rs_lst <- rs_2015winter %>% projectRaster(., rs_phe, method = "ngb")
output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/sos_lst_2015_winter.jpg")
scatters_lst_phe(rs_lst = rs_lst,rs_phe= rs_phe, 
                 xlabel = expression(bold(paste('Winter Land Surface Temp / °C', sep = ''))),
                 ylabel = expression(bold(paste('Start of Season / DOY', sep = ''))),
                 output_file = output_dir)

```

5. Analyze the MODIS data
```{r}
library(rgdal)
library(gdalUtils)
library(stringr)
library(sf)

hdf_file_path <- "~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/phenology_MODIS/raw/MCD12Q2.A2001001.h12v04.061.2022073200155.hdf"
hdf_file_path <- path.expand(hdf_file_path)
gdalinfo(hdf_file_path)
sds = get_subdatasets(hdf_file_path) # get subdata

# name format
hdf_tif_name=paste0(unlist(str_split(hdf_file_path,".hdf"))[1],".tif") # change to different subset
hdf_time = str_extract(hdf_file_path,"()[0-9]{7}") 

# change hdf to tif (for different subsets)
gdal_translate(sds[1], dst_dataset = hdf_tif_name)  # change hdf to tiff
hdf_raster=raster(hdf_tif_name)                     # read tiff as raster
# covert F into T
names(hdf_raster)=hdf_time
hdf_raster


dataset <- h5read(hdf_file, name = "dataset_name")
h5close(hdf_file)
```
